mani_generic.speaker: manikandan
mani_generic.text: Thambi, party ulla dhaan. Inga enna pannuringa?
mani_generic.gloss: The party's inside, boy. What are you doing out here?

mani_generic.speaker: hari
mani_generic.text: Summa dhaan anna, konjam kaathu vaanga.
mani_generic.gloss: Nothing, anna, just getting some air.

mani_overhear.speaker: manikandan
mani_overhear.text: Selvam, sonna kelu da. Indha pakkam vaaradha. Ivanga ellam kudichitu irukaanga… Kadal Amma paathukuva. Seri, seri.
mani_overhear.gloss: Selvam, listen to me. Don't come to this side. They're all drinking… Kadal Amma will look after us. OK, OK.

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: hari
mani_ask_selvam.text: Anna… Selvam epdi irukkaan? Unga nephew dhaane?

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: manikandan
mani_ask_selvam.text: …Ungalukku eppadi theriyum? Indha party-la yaarum en peru kooda kekkala, thambi.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: …How do you know? Nobody at this party has even asked my name, boy.

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: hari
mani_ask_selvam.text: Advay sir keys kettaa, kudukaadheenga. Please anna.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: If Advay sir asks for the keys, don't give them. Please, anna.

mani_ask_selvam.speaker: manikandan
mani_ask_selvam.text: Seri thambi. Saavi en kitta dhaan irukkum.
mani_ask_selvam.gloss: OK, boy. The keys stay with me.
